Thanks team — quick recap and asks from this morning's webinar: 

High level numbers:
- Registered: 1,140
- Attended live: 420
- Replay sign-ups: 610 (we have the export attached)

I've attached attendee_export_20290514.csv and a small preview (top25-accounts-preview.csv) with a first-pass scoring (size + role + engagement). Please do the following by EOD tomorrow (24 hours):

1) SDR claims: Ben — can you split the claims across the two SDR pools and post the assignment in HubSpot? Use the "Hot" threshold (score >= 75) for immediate outreach.
2) VIP outreach: Marissa — I flagged 8 VIPs in the preview (CEOs/VPs). Can you draft the VIP outreach and propose a 2-business-day cadence?
3) Routing tweak: Grace — I put a how-to note in the Drive link for adding the webinar score into the contact timeline; please confirm if we should bump threshold for EMEA accounts.

Notes on prioritization (suggested):
- Tier A (Hot): company_size > $50M OR title contains "Head/VP/CTO" and engagement >= 60
- Tier B (Warm): company_size 10–50M and engagement 40–59
- Tier C (Nurture): the rest → nurture drip with replay link

Attachments: attendee_export_20290514.csv (CSV), top25-accounts-preview.csv (CSV), webinar_replay_short_clip.mp4 (for quick outreach)

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4372 and the Drive folder with the full clip: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3CdefGH

I'll collate claim assignments into the Deal RDWD-4372 once you post them.

Thanks — Alex
